notes.title: Carrying Update 1
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/

Hello Pizza Chefs!

Here's the first update on ordering pizza ingredients and delivering them to your restaurant!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447011/edaa11d68f230d339a5bcb256816edc2b39ac39a.jpg

* The Supply Truck's cargo limit has been increased, and a warning will now appear when you reach the limit.

* Order limits for some ingredients, such as Pizza Dough, have been increased.

* Bugs related to ingredient transportation have been fixed.

Transport Cart is being prepared for the next update!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447011/a9cb183be94d8e4febf8aa6f13721d5a0047313f.png

notes.title: Road Food Simulator - Major Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/

Hello Pizza Chefs !

A new Major Update is here for Road Food Simulator

Upgrades:
* You'll be able to increase your oven's cooking speed.
* You'll be able to increase your customer arrival speed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447011/7224d3dd3d0fb971c549915dda94910384664191.png

Customer Reviews:
* Whether satisfied or disappointed, all your customers will leave reviews about their experiences.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45447011/67eb16b91163748879f16641e58c7598a451054a.png


* Numerous bug fixes.


Add Road Food Simulator to your wishlist and follow it now!

notes.title: New Demo Released!
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/

Here is the demo of our beloved game Road Food Simulator,

Run a roadside Pizza restaurant with your friends. Play solo or in Co-op with other players. Make pizzas fast and fill orders. Keep your customers happy and get more orders. Improve your restaurant as your income increases.

What's in the demo version?

In the demo version, you can serve, cook and order like in the full version (of course, there will be many more types of pizza and cooking techniques in the full version).

2 Types of Pizza are waiting for you in the Road Food Simulator Demo version: Cheese Pizza and Pepperoni Pizza (our two favorites :))

You can prepare and serve these two types of pizza to your customers.

We want to add one last thing, please write to us about any bugs you encounter. We have a great time until the early access version is released.

We know that there are much more experienced pizza lovers and chefs among you. We need your ideas to improve Road Food Simulator. We are also waiting for your suggestions!


2Medya Game Studio team, consisting entirely of pizza lovers

notes.title: Demo and Roadmap
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/

The Demo version we prepared for Road Food Simulator has been closed for gameplay. Thanks to everyone who downloaded and played the demo version of our game.

* The Demo version should still be on your computer and not deleted from your Save files. Those who downloaded the game can try playing offline. However, it will no longer work on Steam.

When is the 2nd Demo?

Yes, we are preparing a more comprehensive 2nd demo with the feedback we received from you. This demo will provide you with longer game time.

Pizza Roadmap!

We are working hard to provide you with great pizzas. Here is our roadmap. If you have any ideas, please let us know and we will add them to the roadmap.


https://trello.com/b/BuYUXAIR/road-food-simulator-roadmap



Soft Drinks and Bottled Water Development Video

notes.title: Soft Drinks & Bottled Water Update
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3207670/Road_Food_Simulator/

Hello Pizza Lovers!

Development continues for the full version of Road Food Simulator.

Soft Drinks and Bottled Water Development

When your customers want to drink something with their Pizza, they will have many options.

From the famous brand Zulu drinks in the Road Food Simulator world;

Zulu Cola
Zulu Lemon
Baller Juice

and of course bottled fresh water!

* In addition to these, 3 types of energy drinks are also being developed.

You can see the drinks in the video below:

[previewyoutube=-0yqqdjaVws;full][/previewyoutube]
